plugin.forms.markup.title: Form markup
plugin.forms.markup.description: What your website gets for this form: plain HTML with no styles, and a small inline script that sends it in place. Data attributes say what each part is.
plugin.forms.markup.unavailable: Save the form to see its markup. Forms with environments must be published first.
plugin.forms.markup.send.note: Pass script: false to renderForm to send the form with your own script, like this one. Without any script, the browser posts the form itself and comes back to the page with ?form=<key>&status=sent or status=error. Forms that check a captcha need a widget that writes its token to a _captcha input.
plugin.forms.export.title: Submissions
plugin.forms.export.description: Download every stored submission of this form as a CSV file.
